instructions.question: What overall attitude does this Facebook comment on a Kosovo public-health COVID-19 post express: positive, neutral or negative?
instructions.rule: Praise, thanks, congratulations, good wishes or prayers ('Zoti na rujt', 'Elhamdulilah', 'urime') are positive, even when tagged at a name or mixed with criticism of politicians. Accusations of lying or faked numbers, insults, swearing, angry complaints and despair about the situation are negative. Bare name tags, questions, statistics, betting or number jokes, and calm suggestions or advice (even worried ones) are neutral.

neutral.what: Comments with no clear evaluation: names only, questions, statistics, speculation, number-betting jokes, requests or suggestions about measures, factual remarks.
examples: Rahime Musliu
Qyteti? (Which city?)
Mu prish bastorja 30+ e pata !! (My bet broke, I had 30+)
Zbutni masat zbutni.. (Ease the measures)
neutral.cues: bare personal names; question marks; a ka (is there); qysh (how); numbers/percentages; bast/koeficient (bet/odds); duhet me (should); zbutni (ease)
neutral.not_for: Names plus praise/greeting are positive; suggestions laced with accusations, insults or 'turp/marre' (shame) are negative.

positive.what: Approval, gratitude, congratulations, relief, hope, blessings or prayers for recovery, including a tagged name followed by a cheerful greeting.
examples: Ju lumte per punen suksese! (Well done for the work, success!)
Zoti na rujt (God protect us)
Hamit Fetahi sa mir (Hamit Fetahi how nice)
Bravo shendetsia me kushtet qe i kini,mjer politika... (Bravo to healthcare given your conditions, shame on politics...)
positive.cues: bravo; ju lumte (well done); urime (congratulations); respekt; faleminderit (thank you); suksese (success); hajde more perhajr (come on, good news); elhamdulilah (praise God); inshallah; sherim (recovery); super lajm (great news)
positive.not_for: Sarcastic praise such as 'Mashalla ju koft 13 testime' or 'Admin rakin e dopt' is negative; bets on numbers ('Mu prish bastorja') are neutral.

negative.what: Anger, distrust, accusations that numbers are fake or copied, insults, vulgar swearing, blaming government or people, fear and despair.
examples: Mos rreni ma shum (Stop lying more)
Ta bajn mut na per dy dit mena dhan liri (Damn them, they gave us freedom for two days)
Instituti Kombëtar...Jo 195 raste po 183,veq copy paste (Not 195 cases but 183, just copy paste)
Turp të kini (Shame on you)
negative.cues: rreni/rrejt (lying); copy paste; marre/turp (shame); mut (shit); nanen (swearing); qifsha; mashtrus (fraud); faj (fault); keq (bad); hup kontrollen (lost control)
negative.not_for: Plain worried advice to wear masks or neutral calls for closures without blame are neutral.
